arabic_text: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ صَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ كَمَثَلِ صَاحِبِ الإِبِلِ الْمُعَقَّلَةِ، إِنْ عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهَا أَمْسَكَهَا، وَإِنْ أَطْلَقَهَا ذَهَبَتْ
english_translation: The example of the one who memorises the Quran is like the owner of hobbled camels. If he tends to them, he keeps them; if he lets them go, they wander away.
question: What does the Hadith compare the one who memorises the Quran to?

options.A: The owner of a flock of sheep
